correctness.rationale: At depth d every union of the finitely many depth types is Boolean-definable by characteristic formulas. A discordant pair of distinct neighbor types is distinguished from every other pair by the singleton tests; an endpoint or agreeing pair never falsifies a test. Retaining the old type therefore gives exactly depth-at-most equivalence, and an equal count at consecutive steps means the partition is fixed. Independent direct evaluation on all n2^n states reproduced 2,2; 2,4,4; 2,4,12,14,14; 2,4,14,36,40,40; and 2,4,14,52,110,122,122. Hence 14 full P4 types and 2^14 definable meanings, with the strict last split at depth 3. For P2 and P3 jointly, all endpoints and neutral centers have only their atomic type, while a discordant P3 center always sees the same two endpoint types at subsequent rounds, so depth 1 already suffices there. For the all-depth witness A1=0 gives Δ^d f=1+A^d f in F2; the path from root 1 to defect d+1 has distance d, exactly one length-d walk and only internal row indices before the terminal defect. Lower-depth truth agrees by locality. This proves the unbounded hierarchy independently of enumeration.
residual_risks: Counts concern one atom and P2 through P6; neither a general count formula nor minimality of the d+2 world bound is claimed. Uploaded scripts were inspected, not executed.
